home.tagline: Smart Logistics. Safer Routes. Better Connectivity.
home.description: NER SmartLogix is a smart logistics and route assistance platform built for the North Eastern Region of India. Plan your journey with real-time risk intelligence, live network monitoring, and access to emergency facilities across all eight NER states.
home.nerNote: Covering all 8 NER States — Assam, Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim & Tripura
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need for safe NER logistics
home.feat1Desc: Calculate optimised routes with real-time hazard risk scores, distance, duration, and traffic-aware ETA.
home.feat2Desc: Track your route on a live map with OpenStreetMap. Get remaining distance and route alerts in real-time.
home.feat3Desc: Find hospitals, petrol pumps, restaurants, hotels, police stations, and pharmacies along your route.
home.feat4Desc: One-tap access to emergency numbers — Police, Ambulance, NHAI, NDMA — with direct phone dialer.
home.feat5Desc: Stay informed with the top 10 NER alerts including floods, landslides, road blocks, and weather hazards.
